_note: v2 hooks for l'Avenue des Petits Travaux (ST_bricoleurs, S02_home), a tree-lined avenue opening into a high-summer country path with a wooden fence, the gadget-and-odd-jobs street (ST_routine seg015-019). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret color = verb group.

fr_conjuguer_verb.why: JUG → conjuguer = to combine, to join together; also to conjugate a verb (conjuguer ses efforts). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (kohn-zhu-GAY -> kohn-zhew-GAY).

fr_adjoindre_verb.why: ADD + JOIN → s'adjoindre = to take on, to join oneself to (s'adjoindre un assistant). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. GOLD beret = irregular (like joindre).
